transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you too. 

Well, I guess the main thing that made me decide to come in is that for the past few weeks, my eating has just been really off. I’ll end up skipping breakfast and lunch without really meaning to... I just don't even think about food. And then I just kind of pick at dinner, even when my wife cooks. 

I've noticed my jeans are starting to feel pretty loose lately, so I'm definitely dropping weight. I figured I should probably talk to someone about it.
When you think about the weight you have lost, how does that make you feel?

I don't know, really. I guess I don't feel much of anything about it. I'm not trying to lose weight or anything, it's just happening because I'm not eating. It's more just... annoying, I guess? Like, I have to wear a belt now so my pants don't fall down. But I wouldn't say I'm happy or sad about the weight itself. It's just a thing that's happening.
Aside from your appetite, have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in the activities you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I have. Most days lately I just wake up with this... heavy, flat feeling. It's like the apartment is too quiet, you know? Usually I like to play music, but lately, even picking up my guitar doesn't really lift me. I just don't get much out of it right now.
Have you ever experienced a period like this before in your life?

No, I don't think so. I mean, everybody has a bad day here and there, but... nothing like this. This feeling of just not caring about anything, and not eating... it's new for me. I haven't really dealt with this kind of thing before.
Have you noticed any changes in how quickly you move or speak, or have others mentioned that you seem to be moving more slowly than usual?

Yeah, I have noticed that. Everything just feels... slower right now. Like, I'll just sit there with my laptop open for ages before I even move my hands to type, or plug in the keyboard. It just takes a while to actually get moving.
Have you found that your current state is so severe that you are completely unable to carry out your daily work or social activities?

No, it's not like I'm completely unable to do anything. I'm still keeping up with basic things around the apartment. But... my music projects have definitely stalled. I've been missing chances to follow through with some musicians I had contacted earlier. I just haven't had the energy to keep those connections going or get any real work done. So I can still function, it's just... everything important has kind of ground to a halt.
How have you been sleeping lately?

I mean, I'm sleeping, but it's pretty broken up. I keep waking up around four or five in the morning, just lying there thinking about bills or those unfinished tracks. I can't really get back to sleep after that, so... I'm basically tired before the day even starts.
Do you find yourself feeling guilty or feeling like you are a burden to others because of how you've been feeling lately?

No, not really. I don't feel like a burden to anyone, mostly because I live alone and keep to myself. And I don't really feel guilty about it either. It's just frustrating that I can't get my work done, but I don't feel like I'm letting anyone down or anything like that.
When you are lying awake early in the morning with these thoughts, have you ever felt that life is not worth living or considered ending your life?

No, no nothing like that. I mean... I get stressed out lying there thinking about money and my music, but I've never felt like life isn't worth living. And I definitely haven't thought about ending my life. It's just... it's frustrating being awake when I want to sleep, but my thoughts don't really go anywhere dark like that.
When you are sitting there with your laptop, do you ever feel physically restless or unable to sit still, or is it always that sense of being slowed down?

No, I don't really get restless. It's definitely more of that slowed down feeling. Everything just feels... slower right now. Like, I'll sit there with my laptop open for ages, and it takes a while before I even move my hands to type or plug in the keyboard. It's just hard to get going.
When you are trying to work on your music projects, do you find it difficult to focus or make simple decisions?

Yeah, actually, I do. It's really hard to focus right now. When I try to work on code or, you know, arrange a song, I just get stuck. I'll keep rereading the exact same line of code over and over, or I'll replay the same eight bars of a track, and I just... I can't decide what to do next. It's like my brain just won't make a choice.
